en.headline: 18 commits across three repositories, plus one issue comment
en.summary: The daily totals record **18 commits**, 0 pull requests, 1 issue, and 0 reviews. Activity comprised 18 own commits plus 9 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 11 own commits revised the code map baseline, added the `opencode-go-minimax` provider before `longcat`, adjusted Minimax reasoning effort, ran temporary CI probes, and removed the temporary probe workflow. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 6 own commits created an MV3 page-translation skeleton, removed selection translation, reset state between runs, added validation and DOM smoke tests, introduced JSDoc checking, and added repository guidance. A separate own commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` documented image storage, deletion behavior, and the VACUUM process under the `openchamber-storage` category. The issue count was 1, with the recorded action being a comment on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue `#8`, `[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败`; the issue had 5 comments at collection time. Separately, `btriapitsyn` closed `openchamber/openchamber` issue `#5293`, `[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server`.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 18 次提交，并评论了 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 当日汇总记录了 **18 次提交**、0 个拉取请求、1 个 issue 和 0 次评审。活动包括 18 次本人提交，另有 9 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 11 次本人提交更新了代码映射基线，在 `longcat` 前加入 `opencode-go-minimax` 提供方，调整 Minimax 的 reasoning effort，运行临时 CI 探针并删除临时探针 workflow。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 6 次本人提交创建了仅支持页面翻译的 MV3 骨架，移除选区翻译，加入运行间状态重置、校验与 DOM 冒烟测试，引入 JSDoc 检查并补充仓库指南。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的另 1 次本人提交在 `openchamber-storage` 类别下记录了图片存储、删除行为和 VACUUM 流程。issue 数量为 1，记录的具体操作是评论 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 `#8` issue `[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败`；采集时该 issue 共有 5 条评论。此外，`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 `#5293` issue `[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server`。
